messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — we need a final decision on per-route quotas + token accounting before next week's roadmap review. Customer asks include heavy function-calling, high embedding throughput, and per-route caps. Do we ship per-route throttles + unified token billing at GA?
AJ (Eng): +1 to per-route throttles. Implementation note: enforcement should live at the ingress so we can apply different policies per API key + route without touching runtime.
Tess (Pricing): We need clarity on billing units: input-only vs input+output vs model-specific token weights. Customers want predictable invoices. Suggest default = input+output_tokens, opt-in advanced billing for model-weighted pricing.
Liam (SRE): Enforcement plan ok. We should avoid hard failure on transient spikes — prefer queued requests with 503 fallback after X ms. Also need metric tags for route, plan, and model.
Sara (Prod Ops): Launch phases: 1) Beta with rate warnings and soft limits for 2 customers, 2) opt-in GA with hard limits + dashboards, 3) enforced billing rules. Canary traffic policy recommended.
Sam (Research): For function calling we see repeated short requests with large output tokens. Token accounting must count completion tokens consistently even when tool calling returns streaming chunks. Edge case: tool-called code blocks can be large — ensure usage sampling aligns with billing.
Maya (PM): Proposal summary: default token accounting = input+output, per-route configurable rate_limit(rps) + monthly quota_tokens. Beta: soft enforcement + usage tagging. GA: hard enforcement + billing. Need sign-off from Eng, SRE, Pricing.
AJ (Eng): Questions: do we expose per-route burn rate in API response headers? pref: X-Rate-Limit-Remaining-tokens and X-Quota-Monthly-remaining. That helps client-side backoff.
Tess (Pricing): Yes expose remaining tokens and the billing model id. Example header: `X-Billing-Model: token_v1` and `X-Tokens-Used: 1234`. Also need clear docs and migration path for existing accounts.
Liam (SRE): Ops checklist: metrics emitted, alert if token rate > threshold for 1m, 5m; circuit-breaker for model-down fallback to cheaper variant. Also need replayable logs for disputed bills.
Sara (Prod Ops): Rollout checklist items: opt-in beta flag, two pilot customers (billing + embedded tool callers), dashboard widgets, alert runbooks. Launch criteria: no more than 1 P1 in 48h during beta and billing accuracy within 0.5% in audits.
Maya (PM): Two open scope decisions for roadmap: 1) model-weighted token pricing at GA or later? 2) per-route quota inheritance (global account quota vs per-route override).
Tess (Pricing): Prefer model-weighted later — ship simple unit first to reduce complexity. Per-route overrides: allow overrides for Dedicated/Enterprise only at GA.
AJ (Eng): Implementation timeline estimate: core enforcement + headers = 2 sprints. Model-weighted pricing + billing pipeline = +2 sprints. Per-route override UI = +1 sprint.
Sam (Research): One more: embeddings workload often uses batching. Quota counting should deduct tokens for batched calls proportionally, not per-batch-call. Otherwise customers get billed incorrectly.
Liam (SRE): Agree. Also ensure KV cache hits are not double-billed — count only tokens actually processed by runtime.
Maya (PM): Action items: @AJ implement ingress throttle prototype and response headers; @Tess draft billing migration & docs; @Liam create SLOs + alert thresholds; @Sara run beta plan with two customers; @Sam validate token counting for function calls and batching.
AJ (Eng): I'll push a minimal prototype by EOW.
Tess (Pricing): Draft will be ready for review tomorrow.
Liam (SRE): I'll add alert rules and initial dashboards by mid-week.
Sara (Prod Ops): I'll pull pilot candidates and draft runbooks.
Sam (Research): I'll run token accounting tests on function-calling examples and share a short report.
deploy-bot: Deployment started: rate-limit-prototype -> staging at 2026-03-18T14:22:03Z :rocket:
Maya (PM): Thanks team — we'll reconvene after prototype feedback.
